name: How long does Level 5 drywall finishing add to a project timeline?
description: Level 5 finishing can add 2-4 additional days to the drywall phase due to the skim coat application, drying, and meticulous sanding.

mainEntity.name: How long does Level 5 drywall finishing add to a project timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Achieving a Level 5 drywall finish can add a notable amount of time to a project's timeline compared to lower finish levels. After the initial drywall installation and standard Level 4 taping and mudding are complete, the skim coat application itself requires additional time, typically one to two days for drying and application, depending on the size of the area. This is followed by further drying time and then meticulous sanding. Overall, expect Level 5 to add approximately 2-4 additional days to the drywall finishing phase, depending on project scale and environmental conditions for drying.
